description: Create or update a resource — an infrastructure/topology entity: host, vm, service, endpoint, or provider. Structured attributes (type, address, os, provider, status) and typed relationships go in fields, NOT prose. Use this instead of describing infra inside a card digest.

attrs.description: any other one-line attributes, merged with existing; an empty value removes the key. A role is a card of type "role": {"rank":"worker","project":"api","head":"[[api-head]]","idle_min":"40"}

edges.description: typed relationships, merged with existing: {"runs_on":["hubd"],"depends_on":["postgres"]}. Values are target slugs.

type.description: host | vm | service | endpoint | provider | ... (open vocabulary)

name: hub_resource_set
